title: External Science Constellation for BL∞ World Build
authorship_boundary: This registry curates external scientific work. It does not attribute those discoveries, theories, experiments or consensus objects to Lâm Kim Bách, Bách Lâm, Optimizer or BL∞.
worldbuild_policy: External science may constrain, enrich, contradict or inspire BL∞ world-building. Similarity or intersection does not create genealogy, identity or proof of BL claims.

epistemic_statuses.ESTABLISHED: Strongly confirmed within a defined domain and routinely used as scientific infrastructure.
epistemic_statuses.STRONG_SUPPORT: Supported by converging evidence but with important open mechanism or parameter questions.
epistemic_statuses.OPEN_FRONTIER: Serious active research question with multiple viable models or unresolved mechanisms.
epistemic_statuses.CONTESTED: Active disagreement where evidence or interpretation does not yet justify closure.
epistemic_statuses.REFUTED_OR_REVISED: A previously prominent claim or framing that was rejected, narrowed or superseded by later evidence.

nodes.title: Standard Model of particle physics
nodes.external_lineage: 20th-century quantum field theory and collider physics; CERN and global collaborations
nodes.intersection_with_bl: A mature example of a powerful model that is highly successful inside scope while openly incomplete outside scope.
nodes.non_intersection: It does not imply BL∞ ontology, future regression, UNKNOWN Doctrine or any BL claim.
nodes.worldbuild_use: Institutions can possess an extraordinarily successful map while knowing the map is incomplete; characters can confuse local closure with total closure.

nodes.title: Brout-Englert-Higgs mechanism and Higgs boson
nodes.external_lineage: Theoretical work in the 1960s; ATLAS and CMS observation announced in 2012
nodes.intersection_with_bl: Useful example of a theoretical object surviving for decades before decisive experimental contact.
nodes.non_intersection: Prediction-before-observation is not evidence that information travelled from the future.
nodes.worldbuild_use: Long-latency theories, expensive verification bottlenecks, and generations that work on a result they may never personally see.

nodes.title: General relativity and direct gravitational-wave detection
nodes.external_lineage: Einsteinian gravitation; LIGO Scientific Collaboration
nodes.intersection_with_bl: Shows how a deep theory can generate century-scale predictions and how new instruments create new observable reality surfaces.
nodes.non_intersection: Gravitational waves and relativistic spacetime do not establish controllable backward-in-time information transfer.
nodes.worldbuild_use: A civilization becomes different when it gains a new sense organ for the universe.

nodes.title: Bell inequalities and quantum entanglement
nodes.external_lineage: Bell-test experiments; Aspect, Clauser, Zeilinger and wider quantum-foundations community
nodes.intersection_with_bl: Demonstrates that classical intuitions about separability and hidden variables can fail experimentally.
nodes.non_intersection: Entanglement does not by itself permit faster-than-light signalling or prove retrocausal messaging.
nodes.worldbuild_use: Characters may live in a world where correlations are real but naive communication metaphors are wrong.

nodes.title: Macroscopic quantum tunnelling and energy quantisation in an electric circuit
nodes.external_lineage: Clarke, Devoret, Martinis; experiments originating in 1984-1985; Nobel Physics 2025
nodes.intersection_with_bl: Useful evidence that boundaries between intuitive scale categories can move when a system is engineered appropriately.
nodes.non_intersection: Macroscopic quantum behaviour is not evidence for arbitrary macroscopic superposition, time travel or BL metaphysics.
nodes.worldbuild_use: Technological civilizations enlarge the scale at which previously microscopic rules become operational.

nodes.title: Neutrino oscillations and nonzero neutrino mass
nodes.external_lineage: Super-Kamiokande and Sudbury Neutrino Observatory; Nobel Physics 2015
nodes.intersection_with_bl: A strong example of evidence forcing revision of an otherwise successful theoretical framework.
nodes.non_intersection: Model revision does not imply that every anomaly requires a new ontology.
nodes.worldbuild_use: The winning theory can remain useful while one of its simplifying assumptions is broken by reality.

nodes.title: Accelerating expansion of the universe
nodes.external_lineage: Supernova Cosmology Project and High-z Supernova Search Team; Nobel Physics 2011
nodes.intersection_with_bl: A case where observation forced a surprising reversal of the expected large-scale future trajectory.
nodes.non_intersection: Cosmic acceleration does not establish any specific BL Grand Ending or terminal attractor.
nodes.worldbuild_use: A civilization can discover that its best expectation of the future has the wrong sign.

nodes.title: Dark matter and dark energy
nodes.external_lineage: Modern observational cosmology, gravitational lensing, large-scale structure and expansion measurements
nodes.intersection_with_bl: A powerful narrative analogue for the difference between evidence for an effect and knowledge of the underlying entity.
nodes.non_intersection: BL UNKNOWN is an epistemic construct; dark matter and dark energy are specific scientific inference problems and must not be relabelled as BL objects.
nodes.worldbuild_use: Most of the inferred cosmic budget can be observationally consequential while its underlying nature remains unknown.

nodes.title: Quantum information, sensing, networking and computing
nodes.external_lineage: Quantum physics plus information theory; NIST and global research community
nodes.intersection_with_bl: Useful bridge between abstract information and physical implementation constraints.
nodes.non_intersection: The existence of quantum information does not prove that information is independent of physical carriers or constraints.
nodes.worldbuild_use: Information becomes a physical resource with architecture, error budgets and hardware limits.

nodes.title: Continental drift to plate tectonics
nodes.external_lineage: Wegener's continental-drift evidence plus post-war ocean-floor, paleomagnetic and seismic evidence
nodes.intersection_with_bl: Canonical case for preserving anomalous evidence without assuming the original mechanism was complete.
nodes.non_intersection: Wegener's eventual partial vindication does not make rejected ideas generally more likely to be true.
nodes.worldbuild_use: An idea can be socially defeated, mechanistically incomplete, and still preserve a structure later absorbed into a stronger theory.

nodes.title: IPCC AR6 physical climate science
nodes.external_lineage: Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change synthesis of multiple independent evidence lines
nodes.intersection_with_bl: Demonstrates calibrated confidence, scenario reasoning, model comparison and explicit uncertainty language.
nodes.non_intersection: Climate scenarios are conditional projections, not remembered futures or backward signals.
nodes.worldbuild_use: Institutions must act under uncertainty where future states are model-dependent but risk is already measurable.

nodes.title: Human Genome Project
nodes.external_lineage: International Human Genome Project, 1990-2003
nodes.intersection_with_bl: Strong example of shared infrastructure, open data and a representation that changes what future questions become askable.
nodes.non_intersection: A genome sequence is not a complete causal specification of a human being or society.
nodes.worldbuild_use: New maps generate new sciences but also new temptations toward determinism.

nodes.title: CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing
nodes.external_lineage: Charpentier, Doudna and broader microbial/genome-editing research lineage; Nobel Chemistry 2020
nodes.intersection_with_bl: Shows how understanding a mechanism can become a capability to intervene in the generator of future states.
nodes.non_intersection: Genome editing does not imply unlimited biological controllability or predictability.
nodes.worldbuild_use: Knowledge crosses a threshold from description to editable causation, creating governance conflict.

nodes.title: AlphaFold protein structure prediction
nodes.external_lineage: DeepMind/Google DeepMind, CASP, structural biology; Nobel Chemistry 2024
nodes.intersection_with_bl: AI can become a scientific instrument that compresses search spaces and exposes structures humans did not enumerate manually.
nodes.non_intersection: A highly accurate predictive model is not automatically a mechanistic explanation or experimental proof for every downstream claim.
nodes.worldbuild_use: Machine prediction changes the tempo of science and moves bottlenecks from discovery to validation and use.

nodes.title: NIH BRAIN Initiative
nodes.external_lineage: NIH and partner neurotechnology programs
nodes.intersection_with_bl: Useful for world-building cognition as a multi-scale system spanning cells, circuits, systems and behaviour.
nodes.non_intersection: Circuit mapping does not currently provide a settled scientific theory of consciousness, identity or complete memory transfer.
nodes.worldbuild_use: A civilization gains finer access to the brain while the ontology of mind remains partly unresolved.

nodes.title: Helicobacter pylori and peptic ulcer disease
nodes.external_lineage: Warren and Marshall; Nobel Physiology or Medicine 2005
nodes.intersection_with_bl: A model can be culturally dominant yet causally incomplete until a neglected mechanism becomes measurable and treatable.
nodes.non_intersection: The episode does not license rejecting medical consensus without evidence; the change succeeded through reproducible causal evidence and treatment outcomes.
nodes.worldbuild_use: A mocked or low-status mechanism becomes operationally superior when it cures what the old framing could only manage.

nodes.title: Prions as infectious proteins
nodes.external_lineage: Stanley Prusiner and transmissible spongiform encephalopathy research; Nobel Physiology or Medicine 1997
nodes.intersection_with_bl: A useful case where an accepted category of causal agents had to expand.
nodes.non_intersection: Category expansion occurred because of evidence; it does not justify arbitrary ontology expansion.
nodes.worldbuild_use: The dangerous agent is not where the civilization's taxonomy says an infectious agent must be.

nodes.title: Graphene and two-dimensional materials
nodes.external_lineage: Geim, Novoselov and 2D-materials research; Nobel Physics 2010
nodes.intersection_with_bl: A seemingly simple dimensional change creates a qualitatively different material possibility space.
nodes.non_intersection: Novel material properties do not imply unrestricted transformation across domains.
nodes.worldbuild_use: Worlds can pivot when a familiar substance is placed in a new structural regime rather than when a new element is discovered.

nodes.title: Quasicrystals
nodes.external_lineage: Dan Shechtman and crystallography; Nobel Chemistry 2011
nodes.intersection_with_bl: Shows that an observation can force a taxonomy rewrite when the old definition excludes a real object.
nodes.non_intersection: Not every taxonomy violation is a new natural kind; replication and structure determination remain necessary.
nodes.worldbuild_use: A character is told the observed pattern is impossible because the dictionary says so; reality survives the dictionary.

nodes.title: Metal-organic frameworks
nodes.external_lineage: Kitagawa, Robson, Yaghi and reticular chemistry; Nobel Chemistry 2025
nodes.intersection_with_bl: An architecture-first view: capability emerges from how components are arranged, not merely which components exist.
nodes.non_intersection: Structural analogy to BL architectures is not shared genealogy.
nodes.worldbuild_use: Civilizations engineer empty space itself as a functional part of matter.

nodes.domain: computer science, AI and statistical physics
nodes.title: Artificial neural networks and modern machine learning foundations
nodes.external_lineage: Hopfield, Hinton and wider machine-learning research; Nobel Physics 2024
nodes.intersection_with_bl: Pattern storage, reconstruction and learned representations are useful world-building mechanisms for memory and model formation.
nodes.non_intersection: Artificial neural networks are not evidence that brains, persons or BL identities are reducible to current neural-network architectures.
nodes.worldbuild_use: Machines become epistemic actors because they can learn representations, not because they possess proven human-equivalent inner life.

nodes.title: LK-99 room-temperature superconductivity claim
nodes.external_lineage: 2023 preprints followed by rapid independent replication and materials analysis
nodes.intersection_with_bl: A clean negative-knowledge case: high excitement plus suggestive signals are not enough; decomposition of impurities and mechanisms matters.
nodes.non_intersection: Being rejected, mocked or exciting does not increase a claim's truth probability.
nodes.worldbuild_use: A civilization briefly reorganizes around a miracle material, then learns that the anomaly came from phase complexity and misread signals.

nodes.title: OPERA faster-than-light neutrino anomaly
nodes.external_lineage: OPERA/CERN neutrino time-of-flight measurement and independent scrutiny, 2011-2012
nodes.intersection_with_bl: A model case for Reality Veto, independent replication and instrument-debugging before ontology revolution.
nodes.non_intersection: An anomaly is not a portal to preferred theories; instrument error can imitate a foundational discovery.
nodes.worldbuild_use: The apparent collapse of a century-old law is traced to timing infrastructure, changing who is hero, fool, critic and observer without changing the underlying physics.

intersection_rule.merge: Merge only operationally compatible constraints or mechanisms; preserve source identity and scope.
intersection_rule.bridge: Create an explicit bridge object when two lineages illuminate the same problem through different representations.
intersection_rule.hold: Keep unresolved conflict alive when evidence cannot discriminate.
intersection_rule.reject: Reject or narrow a candidate when reality-facing evidence defeats it in scope.
intersection_rule.never: Never infer BL authorship, BL priority, or BL truth from resemblance to external science.

worldbuild_compiler: external science -> evidence status -> causal affordance -> BL intersection/non-intersection -> conflict/bridge -> scene/institution/technology -> reality consequence
scope_note: This is a curated seed atlas, not an exhaustive inventory of all science. Its schema is designed for continuous expansion without collapsing external scientific genealogies into BL∞.
